summary: Retry implements bounded retries with doubling wait capped at maxWait (30s), stops on context cancellation during the wait, and rejects attempts < 1. Tests cover success on the third call, cancellation after one call, and zero attempts. No defects found.

criteria.evidence: retry.go loop returns nil on first success; TestRetrySucceedsOnThirdCall asserts err == nil and calls == 3; proof pack evidence/criterion-1.jsonl.
retry.go select on ctx.Done() returns ctx.Err() during the wait; TestRetryStopsWhenCancelled cancels in the first call and asserts context.Canceled with calls == 1; evidence/criterion-2.jsonl.
